problems.title: Shift both roots without finding them
problems.question: a,b solve x²-199x-199=0. Find (a+2)(b+2).
problems.idea: Expand using the root sum and product.

problems.title: Both square roots equal an absolute value
problems.question: Solve √(x²)=√((-x)²).
problems.idea: The nonnegative square root removes the sign.
steps: The two sides agree for every real x.

problems.title: Appending a digit and multiplying
problems.question: Two natural numbers have product 260, and one is formed by appending 2 to the other. Find their sum.
steps: The positive natural value is n=5, with the other number 52.

problems.title: Centre-to-side distance in a rhombus
problems.question: A rhombus has side 24 and acute angle 30°. Find the distance from its diagonal intersection to a side.
problems.idea: The centre is halfway between parallel sides.

problems.title: A rhombus inscribed in a rectangle
problems.question: K∈AB,M∈CD of rectangle ABCD and AKCM is a rhombus. The longer rectangle side is 24 and BAC=30°. Find KM.
problems.idea: Use rectangle coordinates and equal rhombus sides.
steps: Thus KM has components (-8,8√3) and length √(64+192)=16.

problems.title: A closed interval shrinks to one point
problems.question: The system 3x+2≥a²+a,4x+3≤a²+2a has exactly one solution x. Find x.
problems.idea: Its lower and upper bounds must be equal.

problems.title: Centre a quartic at x=1
problems.question: Find the sum of real roots of (x²-2x)²-(x-1)²-11=0.
steps: The roots are x=1±√5, whose sum is 2.

problems.title: Factor a cubic through a repeated quadratic
problems.question: Find the product of roots of x(x-1)(x+199)+x²+198x-199=0.

problems.title: A right trapezoid with two equalities
problems.question: A right trapezoid’s shorter leg equals its shorter base, and its longer leg equals its shorter diagonal. Find larger diagonal/larger base.
problems.idea: Let the height and shorter base both be t.
steps: Equality to √2t gives (B-t)²=t². Since B>t, B=2t.

problems.title: Double the base angle, then take its supplement
problems.question: An isosceles triangle’s base angle β has cosβ=3/5. Find its apex-angle cosine.

problems.title: A cancelled denominator can remove an algebraic root
problems.question: Count real solutions of 2/(x²-x+1)=1/(x+1)+(2x-1)/(x³+1).
steps: Multiply through by (x+1)(x²-x+1). The equation becomes 2(x+1)=x²-x+1+2x-1=x²+x.
Reject x=-1 from the original denominator, leaving x=2.

problems.title: Two radical expressions are rational
problems.question: Which two are rational: a=√796; b=(6√7-3)²+(2+9√7)²; c=1/(√5+1)+1/(√5-1); d=√784?
steps: The radicand 796 is not a perfect square, so a is irrational.
The two fractions in c sum to 2√5/4=√5/2, irrational.

problems.title: Radical signs on a nonpositive domain
problems.question: Simplify x√(-x)+√(-y⁵).
steps: The first equality uses -x≥0; the second extracts the perfect square y⁴.

problems.title: Three feet on a right-triangle hypotenuse
problems.question: CH,CL,CM are the altitude,bisector,median from right vertex C. HL=1,LM=2. Find hypotenuse c=AB.
problems.idea: Assume the longer leg is b=AC; reversing the labels gives the same lengths.
steps: Along AB from A, the feet occur in order M,L,H, so HM=HL+LM=3.
Also LM=c(b-a)/(2(a+b))=c/(2√3). Set LM=2 to obtain c=4√3.

problems.title: An isosceles trapezoid diagonal
problems.question: A trapezoid has bases 1,2 and both legs 1. Find a diagonal.
problems.idea: Use its height and the diagonal’s horizontal projection.

problems.title: A reciprocal cube difference
problems.question: Evaluate [1/(y√y)-1/(x√x)]·[1/x+1/√(xy)+1/y]⁻¹ divided by (√x-√y), at x=8⁻²,y=4.
steps: The first two factors combine as [(u³-v³)/(u³v³)]·[u²v²/(u²+uv+v²)]=(u-v)/(uv).
Divide by u-v to obtain 1/√(xy), with x,y>0,x≠y.

problems.title: Add two repeating decimals as fractions
problems.question: Find 0.3(12)+0.4(65).
problems.idea: Subtract the nonrepeating prefix from the first full prefix-and-block integer.

problems.title: A square root can exceed any fixed real bound
problems.question: For which a does √(x-199)≥a have at least one real solution?
steps: That input is in the domain and gives square root max(a,0), which is at least a.

problems.title: Sum two circle diameters
problems.question: A triangle has sides 5,12,13. Find circumcircle diameter plus incircle diameter.

problems.title: An isosceles tangent-bisector triangle
problems.question: AD bisects A. The circumcircle tangent at A meets ray BC at E. Given BC=6,CE=2, find ED.
steps: E lies beyond C, so EB=BC+CE=8.
The equal angles EAD=ADE give ED=EA.

problems.title: Equal absolute values have two sign branches
problems.question: Find the sum of squared roots of |3x-1|=|2x+1|.
problems.idea: Equate the inner expressions with both signs.

problems.title: A cube increase determines a negative input
problems.question: A negative number is increased by 1, increasing its cube by 48¼. Find the original number.

problems.title: Tangent and cotangent roots have product one
problems.question: A quadratic ax²+bx+c=0 has roots tanα,cotα for an acute α. What coefficient relation must hold?

problems.title: Mass points along a median
problems.question: M lies on median AD with AM:MD=2:3. Ray BM meets AC at T. Find AT:TC.

problems.title: Similar triangles from one shared and one equal angle
problems.question: D∈BC, BAD=BCA, AB=2AD and AC=6. Find BC.
problems.idea: Triangles BAD and BCA are similar.
formulas: Their B-angles agree because BD follows BC; their given A,C angles also agree.
